sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普林。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson, and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森，欢迎收听《重构者》，一档专注于设计之美及其周围文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth
sentences.zh: 甚至早在黑胶唱片时代我在夜店打碟的时候，每晚你都要带300件你最珍爱的藏品去上班，然后你把DJ台

sentences.en: into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 变成了一个充满美感的、50年前老物件的微型快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在即可在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, a lone gunman with no history of crime booked a suite at a Las Vegas hotel and fatally shot at least 59 people.
sentences.zh: 今天，一名没有犯罪记录的独行枪手在拉斯维加斯的一家酒店预订了一间套房，并开枪射杀、致死至少59人。

sentences.en: What we know about one of the deadliest mass shootings in U.S.
sentences.zh: 关于美国历史上

sentences.en: history.
sentences.zh: 最致命的大规模枪击案之一，我们所了解的情况。

sentences.en: And a single day in Puerto Rico as President Trump arrives to survey the wreckage from Hurricane Maria.
sentences.zh: 以及在波多黎各的单一一天，随着特朗普总统抵达现场视察玛丽亚飓风造成的残骸。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, October 3rd.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月3日，星期二。

sentences.en: Richard Perez-Pena, what do we know at this point about what happened inside this hotel room in Las Vegas?
sentences.zh: 理查德·佩雷斯-佩尼亚，目前我们对拉斯维加斯这家酒店房间里发生的事情了解多少？

sentences.en: A man named Steven Paddock, who lived in Mesquite, Nevada, and who was a wealthy person who liked to gamble, apparently,
sentences.zh: 一个名叫斯蒂芬·帕多克的人，他住在内华达州梅斯基特，是一个喜欢赌博的有钱人，显然，

sentences.en: had checked into a high-level suite in the Mandalay Bay Casino Resort.
sentences.zh: 他入住曼德拉湾赌场度假村的高层套房。

sentences.en: It's this very fancy, luxurious hotel casino on the south end of the Las Vegas Strip.
sentences.zh: 这是拉斯维加斯大道南端一家非常高档、奢华的酒店赌场。

sentences.en: He'd been there for a couple of days in a suite that had multiple rooms on the 32nd floor, so very near the top, apparently smashed out the windows with a hammer
sentences.zh: 他在那儿待了好几天，套房位于32层，有多间客房，显然非常靠近顶楼，他用锤子砸碎了窗户，

sentences.en: and had an arsenal with him.
sentences.zh: 并且随身携带了一个军火库。

sentences.en: And in the two windows that he smashed out, he had set up on tripods rifles with scopes.
sentences.zh: 在他砸碎的两扇窗户里，他架设了带有瞄准镜的三角架步枪。

sentences.en: They were AR-15-style assault rifles, which apparently, we don't know this for certain yet, but seemed to be the main weapons that he used in the shooting.
sentences.zh: 它们是AR-15风格的突击步枪，显然——虽然我们现在还不能百分之百确定——但这似乎是他在此次枪击事件中使用的主要武器。

sentences.en: And what was happening on the ground below where he was finding his targets?
sentences.zh: 那么在他寻找目标的下方地面上发生了什么？

sentences.en: So this was this three-day country music festival called the Route 91 Harvest Festival.
sentences.zh: 这是一个为期三天的乡村音乐节，名为91号公路丰收音乐节。

sentences.en: And at the time of the shooting, the police were estimating there were 22,000 people on this scene.
sentences.zh: 枪击发生时，警方估计现场有22,000人。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was basically just a big empty lot where they'd set it up.
sentences.zh: 是的，它基本上就是一个搭起舞台的大空地。

sentences.en: All of a sudden, we just heard, like, three or four little pop, pop, pop.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，我们只听到三四声很小的砰、砰、砰。

sentences.en: And a lot of people at first thought...
sentences.zh: 很多人一开始以为……

sentences.en: Everybody kind of looked around and said, oh, it's just firecrackers.
sentences.zh: 大家都环顾四周，说，哦，只是鞭炮而已。

sentences.en: And then we heard pop, pop, pop.
sentences.zh: 然后我们又听到砰、砰、砰。

sentences.en: And it just kept going and going.
sentences.zh: 而且声音一直响个不停。

sentences.en: And my husband said, that's not firecrackers.
sentences.zh: 我丈夫说，那不是鞭炮。

sentences.en: That sounds like a semiotic rifle.
sentences.zh: 听起来像半自动步枪。

sentences.en: And they didn't immediately react.
sentences.zh: 他们没有立即做出反应。

sentences.en: We refused to believe it was a shooting until it just kept going and going.
sentences.zh: 我们拒绝相信这是一场枪击，直到枪声一直持续不断。

sentences.en: Or if they did, they did what you would ordinarily do when you think that there's gunfire, which is you hit the ground.
sentences.zh: 或者说，如果他们反应了，他们就会做出当你认为有枪声时通常会做的事，那就是趴在地上。

sentences.en: But if the person's firing from on high, that's not going to help you.
sentences.zh: 但如果凶手是从高处往下开枪，那对你毫无帮助。

sentences.en: We're just all sitting there looking at each other, like, thinking that we're going to die.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人都坐在那里看着彼此，以为我们要死了。

sentences.en: And a security guard got shot right in front of us.
sentences.zh: 一个保安就在我们面前中枪了。

sentences.en: Another guy got shot right next to me.
sentences.zh: 另一个人就在我旁边中枪了。

sentences.en: You know, we just thought we were going to die.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们当时只觉得我们要死了。

sentences.en: So I called my mom, to be honest with you.
sentences.zh: 所以老实说，我给我妈打了电话。

sentences.en: I was just calling my mom to tell my mom that I love her and goodbye.
sentences.zh: 我只是打电话告诉我妈我爱她，然后说再见。

sentences.en: There were bursts of gunfire and then pauses in between.
sentences.zh: 一阵阵的枪声，中间夹杂着停顿。

sentences.en: Either he was reloading or changing weapons or something.
sentences.zh: 要么他在重新装填弹药，要么在更换武器之类的。

sentences.en: And then people started running, and we asked what was going on, and they said it was a shooter.
sentences.zh: 然后人们开始奔跑，我们问发生什么事了，他们说有个枪手。

sentences.en: And then we realized it sounded like machine guns.
sentences.zh: 然后我们意识到这听起来像机枪。

sentences.en: It sounded like more than one machine gun.
sentences.zh: 听起来不止一把机枪。

sentences.en: And it just didn't stop.
sentences.zh: 而且枪声根本停不下来。

sentences.en: And a lot of people, when the second burst came and they understood how bad things actually were, started to run.
sentences.zh: 当第二阵枪声响起，大家明白情况究竟有多糟时，很多人开始逃跑。

sentences.en: And then there was just a complete stampede.
sentences.zh: 接着就完全演变成了一场踩踏事故。

sentences.en: All the walls in the location were about 10 to 15 feet high.
sentences.zh: 现场所有的墙都有大约10到15英尺高。

sentences.en: And you just couldn't climb them.
sentences.zh: 你根本爬不上去。

sentences.en: So everyone was just getting bottlenecked.
sentences.zh: 所以所有人都被堵在了瓶颈处。

sentences.en: There was no escape.
sentences.zh: 根本无路可逃。

sentences.en: We were just pinned in.
sentences.zh: 我们被死死困住了。

sentences.en: It was just a kill box.
sentences.zh: 这里简直就是一个杀戮场。

sentences.en: Richard, what's been so disturbing about this case is how a single person could kill and injure so many people.
sentences.zh: 理查德，这个案子最令人不安的地方在于，一个人怎么能杀死和伤害这么多人。

sentences.en: What do we know so far about how that was possible?
sentences.zh: 对于这怎么可能发生，我们目前了解多少？

sentences.en: Well, this is a thing that comes up with many mass shootings that we've seen, that people are surprised that so much damage can be done by an individual or two people.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是在我们看到的大多数大规模枪击事件中都会出现的问题，人们对一个人或两个人能造成如此大的破坏感到惊讶。

sentences.en: And that's when there aren't even fully automatic weapons involved.
sentences.zh: 而且这甚至还没涉及到全自动武器。

sentences.en: In the Virginia Tech shooting in 2007, a gunman using only pistols, not even rifles, killed 32 people, one shot at a time.
sentences.zh: 在2007年的弗吉尼亚理工大学枪击案中，一名枪手仅仅使用手枪，甚至不是步枪，就逐一枪杀了32人。

sentences.en: This guy, if he had a fully automatic weapon, the only limitation really is on how much time he has to shoot and how much ammunition he has to reload.
sentences.zh: 这家伙，如果他有一把全自动武器，唯一的限制其实就是他有多少时间开枪以及他有多少子弹需要重新装填。

sentences.en: How much time passed from the beginning of the shooting to the end, do we know?
sentences.zh: 从枪击开始到结束过去了多长时间，我们知道吗？

sentences.en: That's not clear.
sentences.zh: 目前还不清楚。

sentences.en: We've heard estimates of maybe seven minutes, 10 minutes, plenty of time to do a lot of killing.
sentences.zh: 我们听到估计大约是七分钟、十分钟，有足够的时间进行大量的杀戮。

sentences.en: And how did the shooting end?
sentences.zh: 枪击是如何结束的？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: SWAT teams swarmed into the hotel and they realized that the shooting was coming from an upper floor.
sentences.zh: 特警队冲进酒店，他们意识到枪声来自高层。

sentences.en: And starting on the 29th floor, they went up going floor by floor, room by room, very methodical, cautious process because you don't know whether he's going to shoot you
sentences.zh: 从29层开始，他们一层接一层、一间房接一间房地往上搜查，这是一个非常系统、谨慎的过程，因为你不知道他是否会在你靠近时

sentences.en: as you approach.
sentences.zh: 向你开枪。

sentences.en: You don't know whether there are booby traps.
sentences.zh: 你不知道有没有诡雷。

sentences.en: And finally, they found him on the 32nd floor.
sentences.zh: 最后，他们在32层找到了他。

sentences.en: And when they entered his room, according to the police, he had already shot and killed himself.
sentences.zh: 据警方称，当他们进入他的房间时，他已经开枪自杀身亡了。

sentences.en: Do we know the motive of the shooter?
sentences.zh: 我们知道枪手的动机吗？

sentences.en: It's early.
sentences.zh: 还为时过早。

sentences.en: That may still be evolving, our understanding.
sentences.zh: 我们对情况的理解可能还在发展中。

sentences.en: But what do we know?
sentences.zh: 但我们到底知道什么？

sentences.en: At this point, nothing.
sentences.zh: 目前什么都不知道。

sentences.en: Absolutely nothing.
sentences.zh: 绝对什么都不知道。

sentences.en: The police are just trying to figure out why on earth.
sentences.zh: 警方正试图弄清楚到底是为了什么。

sentences.en: If they know anything, they haven't said.
sentences.zh: 如果他们知道什么，他们也没说。

sentences.en: And what do we know about the shooter himself?
sentences.zh: 我们对枪手本人了解多少？

sentences.en: 64 years old, retired, lived with his girlfriend.
sentences.zh: 64岁，退休人员，和女友同居。

sentences.en: The neighbors thought of him as a nice, quiet guy.
sentences.zh: 邻居们认为他是一个随和、安静的人。

sentences.en: He has a brother who lives in Orlando, Florida, who's talked to the media a number of times and has said, you know.
sentences.zh: 他有一个弟弟住在佛罗里达州奥兰多，曾多次接受媒体采访，你知道的，他曾说过。

sentences.en: I mean, my brother did this.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我哥哥做出了这种事。

sentences.en: I, this is like it was done, you know, like he shot us.
sentences.zh: 我，这感觉就像是……你知道的，就像他向我们开了枪一样。

sentences.en: I mean,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，

sentences.en: if he'd have killed my kids, I couldn't be more dumbfounded.
sentences.zh: 如果他杀了我孩子，我都不会感到更震惊了。

sentences.en: I mean, it doesn't, there's nothing.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这根本没有……什么都没有。

sentences.en: You know, just completely shocked by this and saying that he was as ordinary a guy as you could hope to meet.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，对此感到极其震惊，并说他是一个你能遇到的最普通不过的人。

sentences.en: He talked about how after Hurricane Irma had blown through Florida, his brother was texting him, checking up on their mother to see how she was and had sent her a walker
sentences.zh: 他谈到在飓风“厄玛”吹袭佛罗里达后，他哥哥给他发短信，询问他们的母亲情况如何，并给她寄了一个助行器

sentences.en: to make sure she could move around.
sentences.zh: 以确保她能够四处走动。

sentences.en: The last time she talked to him, no indication of anything.
sentences.zh: 她最后一次和他通话时，没有任何异常的迹象。

sentences.en: I mean, nothing.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，什么都没有。

sentences.en: We've contacted a gun store where he bought three of his weapons in the last year and the gun store owner said he set off no alarm bells.
sentences.zh: 我们联系了一家枪械店，他在过去一年里在那里买过三把武器，枪械店老板说他没有拉响任何警报。

sentences.en: He passed a background check.
sentences.zh: 他通过了背景调查。

sentences.en: The police where he lives and has lived in the past have all said that he has no criminal history.
sentences.zh: 他现在和过去居住地方的警方都表示他没有任何犯罪历史。

sentences.en: They have no record of him.
sentences.zh: 他们没有任何关于他的案底。

sentences.en: Find out who sold him the machine gun.
sentences.zh: 去查清楚是谁把机枪卖给他的。

sentences.en: There's no,
sentences.zh: 没有……

sentences.en: I don't know what else to say.
sentences.zh: 我不知道该说些什么了。

sentences.en: I just,
sentences.zh: 我只是……

sentences.en: I mean, it's his fault that he did this.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他做这件事是他的错。

sentences.en: I mean, but I'd like to know where he found the machine gun because that's not something that's that easy to come by, I assume.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，但我很想知道他在哪里弄到了机枪，因为我想那不是那么容易搞到的东西。

sentences.en: We do have this one sort of odd possibility, which is that
sentences.zh: 我们确实有一种奇怪的假设，那就是

sentences.en: ISIS has taken credit for this and said that he's a soldier or inspired by them and that he converted to Islam a few months ago.
sentences.zh: “伊斯兰国”已宣称对此次事件负责，称他是他们的士兵或受其启发，并在几个月前皈依了伊斯兰教。

sentences.en: We don't have any of, any confirmation of any of that and some of ISIS's claims in the past
sentences.zh: 我们没有任何……没有任何关于这一点的证实，正如“伊斯兰国”过去的一些声明一样，

sentences.en: what the FBI has said is that so far at least they have no knowledge of his being involved in any extremist group of any kind.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局表示，至少到目前为止，他们不知道他曾参与过任何形式的极端组织。

sentences.en: So finally,
sentences.zh: 所以最后，

sentences.en: Richard, what did President Trump have to say about this attack?
sentences.zh: 理查德，特朗普总统对这次袭击有什么要说的吗？

sentences.en: I believe this is the first time he's had to deal with a mass shooting as president.
sentences.zh: 我相信这是他作为总统第一次必须处理的大规模枪击事件。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The president's response was It was an act of pure evil.
sentences.zh: 总统的回应是：这是一场纯粹的邪恶行径。

sentences.en: Fairly standard for a president talking about bringing people together and making the country safe.
sentences.zh: 这对于一位谈论凝聚人心和确保国家安全的总统来说相当标准。

sentences.en: In moments of tragedy and horror,
sentences.zh: 在悲剧与恐惧的时刻，

sentences.en: America comes together as one and it always has.
sentences.zh: 美国团结一心，而且过去一直如此。

sentences.en: He invoked togetherness and God.
sentences.zh: 他呼吁团结和上帝。

sentences.en: May God bless the souls of the lives that are loSt.
sentences.zh: 愿上帝保佑逝者的灵魂。

sentences.en: May God give us the grace of healing and may God provide the grieving families with strength to carry on.
sentences.zh: 愿上帝赐予我们疗愈的恩典，愿上帝赋予悲伤的家属继续前行的力量。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: God bless America.
sentences.zh: 上帝保佑美国。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Richard, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 理查德，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: On Monday night, police inspecting
sentences.zh: 周一晚间，警方搜查了

sentences.en: Stephen Paddock's home in Mesquite, Nevada, said they had found in excess of 18 more guns as well as explosives and several thousand rounds of ammunition.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬·帕多克位于内华达州梅斯基特的住所，称他们发现了18支以上的枪支、爆炸物以及数千发子弹。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hi,
sentences.zh: 嗨，

sentences.en: I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报Dealbook的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th,
I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 我将在纽约市的Dealbook峰会上现场采访商业、政治和文化领域的一些重量级领袖，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance,
sentences.zh: 万斯、

sentences.en: Elon Musk,
sentences.zh: 埃隆·马斯克、

sentences.en: Christine Lagarde,
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、

sentences.en: Zilran Mondani, and many others live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的现场对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播部分精选访谈，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用来观看，并免费获得一个月的所有新闻阅读权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你绝对不想错过。

sentences.en: It's been almost two weeks since Hurricane Maria made landfall on the U.S.
sentences.zh: 距离玛丽亚飓风登陆美国

sentences.en: territory of Puerto Rico, and 95% of the island still has no electricity.
sentences.zh: 领地波多黎各已经过去了近两周，全岛仍有95%的地区没有电力供应。

sentences.en: 89% of cell phone towers are broken and 73% of ATMs are still not working.
sentences.zh: 89%的手机基站损坏，73%的自动取款机仍无法使用。

sentences.en: With residents frustrated by a delayed response from federal officials and communication to and from the island limited, a group of New York Times reporters traveled
sentences.zh: 由于居民对联邦官员反应迟缓感到沮丧，且岛内外的通信受到限制，《纽约时报》的一组记者前往
